messages:
alex: Quick idea  compact suppression preview + routing priority markers. Instead of listing all channels equally, show the channel that will actually be notified first (with small fallback list). Mock attached.
tanya: can you drop the mock here?
alex: https://internal-assets/redwood/mocks/suppression-preview-priority.png
ravi: Love the intent. Two concerns: 1) people expect to edit suppression windows inline, 2) we need to surface which rule will be used for dedupe (most teams get confused when multiple rules overlap).
morgan: For (2) we could add a tiny tag: "Dedup picks: rule #2" with a hover explain. Keep it subtle.
sylvie: Accessibility note: the priority marker (P1) should have accessible text like "Primary target: PagerDuty" and not rely on color. Also ensure the fallback list is keyboard-traversable.
tanya: Copy suggestion: change "Suppressed until" to "Snoozed until" in the preview header when the suppression is user-initiated. System suppressions (cooldown) should still read "Suppressed by policy".
alexus: +1 on copy, users conflate mute vs snooze. Maybe add a hover tooltip: "Snooze: temporarily pause notifications; re-enables after time."
ravi: UX question: when routing rules route to an alternative channel during peak hours (e.g., route pages to email at night), should the preview reflect current time-of-day routing or show both possibilities? I think show both, with the active one emphasized.
morgan: Implementation note: show active route bold + active icon, other options grayed with small clock icon and label "active at 22:00-06:00".
sylvie: A11y test case: screen reader should announce "Primary: PagerDuty (active) Secondary: Ops-email (night)" and then allow expand to read full routing policy. Also when rows are grouped we should announce how many rules collapsed.
anan: small nit: avoid using chevrons-only to indicate expandable rows. Add "Show details" text for low-vision users.
tanya: Edge case: grouped thresholds that differ only by severity (warning vs critical). We should not compress those into a single summary unless we show severity badges per collapsed item. Otherwise oncall might miss criticals.
alex: Good call. Plan: grouping allowed only if metric+channels+severity all match. For similar-severity but different windows we'll show an inline list on expand.
ravi: Also include a subtle gray line in the preview when fallback is to a different capacity tier: "If Dedicated unavailable -> Hosted" so engineers know which model executes.
sylvie: Accessibility + color: P1 red vs P2 orange isn't enough; include text labels and different shapes for badges (square vs circle) so colorblind folks can distinguish.
design-bot: Reminder: design sync Friday 9am PT 4c5 Please add this item to the agenda and bring the annotated mock. :white_check_mark:
